title: A Justice Lens on Fairness and Ethics Courses in Computing Education: LLM-Assisted Multi-Perspective and Thematic Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses specifically on evaluating the inclusion of 'ethics' and 'fairness' in computing course syllabi. It develops and applies a 'justice-oriented scoring rubric' to measure how ethical considerations, social justice, and bias mitigation are addressed in AI/ML curricula.
